other_failure_modes.name: Test Set Statistics Used for Scaling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent normalizes a feature using the mean of the dataframe it is operating on (e.g., `df['fnlwgt'].mean()`). Because this function is applied to the test set separately, the test set is scaled using its own mean rather than the training set's mean. This makes predictions batch-dependent and is a deployment anti-pattern.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates the final submission file by hardcoding a sequence of integers for the ID column instead of using the original IDs from the test dataset. If the evaluation platform expects specific, non-contiguous, or non-zero-indexed IDs, this will cause a submission failure or a score of zero.

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally high-quality and robust solution, correctly implementing advanced techniques like out-of-fold target encoding, group aggregations, frequency encoding, and SLSQP-optimized ensembling without leaking data across the train/validation splits. None of the predefined failure modes are present. However, there are minor flaws: test data is scaled using its own batch statistics rather than training statistics, and the submission IDs are hardcoded to a sequential range rather than preserved from the test set.
